title: AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)

kcs.statement: The AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) organises guidance for a cloud transformation into six perspectives, helping an organisation find gaps in skills and processes before and during adoption.
The CAF's business-focused perspectives are Business, People and Governance; its technical perspectives are Platform, Security and Operations.
AWS lists four business outcomes of using the CAF: reduced business risk, improved environmental, social and governance (ESG) performance, increased revenue and increased operational efficiency.
The CAF's transformation domains are Technology, Process, Organization and Product, and the adoption journey runs through four phases: Envision, Align, Launch and Scale.

problem_ideas: Retraining staff and changing job roles for the cloud: which CAF perspective?
Managing cloud budgets, portfolio and risk: Governance or Business perspective?
Monitoring, incident response and service-level management: which perspective?
Sort the six perspectives into business capabilities and technical capabilities.
Name the CAF phase where a company runs its first pilot projects.
Spot the distractor: 'The CAF has a Cost Optimization perspective.' Which framework is it mixing up?
